definition: the part of the leg below the ankle
description: Sunset in a vineyard. A hand squeezes a bunch of dark grapes until purple juice runs down the wrist and arm and drips into a crate below. A woman in a red top and an older man tip a crate of grapes into a big wooden vat. Then bare feet come down into the grapes: close shots show the soles and toes pressing and turning in the fruit, the ankles and lower legs stained purple, and finally the two of them stand in the vat and stomp up and down together, laughing, with the rolled-up jeans above their bare feet.

en.question: What are they doing in the vat?

de.answer: Sie zerstampfen Trauben mit ihren bloßen Füßen.
